summary: Complete independent audit of all 244 Chinese units, 396 temporal or active-hint items, and 92 people. Direct regnal-year chronology, dated receptions, and explicit event ownership were reviewed against the Chinese. However, 27 current claims and their derived active hints convert genealogical identity, office labels, retrospective praise, and undated narrative actions into multi-year personal activity intervals. The chapter requires source-scoped repair before it can be research-blocked or approved.
